name: LunaCycle Health
founders: Former women's-health physician and consumer health operator
description: A virtual care platform helping women manage menopause symptoms with clinician-guided care and longitudinal tracking.
evidence: Founder-reported pilot with two independent gynecology practices; published clinical evidence not yet located.
business_model: B2C subscription with employer benefit distribution

name: MaternaPath
founders: Maternal-fetal medicine physician and health-equity researcher
description: Care navigation and remote monitoring for high-risk pregnancies, designed for community clinics and Medicaid populations.
evidence: Pilot outcomes reported by a federally qualified health center; payer reimbursement pathway remains unclear.
business_model: B2B2C contracts with community health centers and payers

name: BiomarkHer
description: A contract-lab-enabled blood test platform investigating biomarkers associated with earlier detection of ovarian cancer.
evidence: Early analytical validation described in a conference poster; clinical utility and regulatory pathway require diligence.
business_model: Testing partnerships with outsourced laboratory infrastructure

name: Mindful Matter
founders: Clinical psychologist and digital product leader
description: A guided behavioral health program for postpartum anxiety combining CBT exercises, peer support, and escalation to licensed clinicians.
evidence: Clinical advisory board disclosed; prospective outcomes study planned but not yet published.

name: CareGrid AI
founders: Health IT engineer and hospital operations executive
description: Ambient documentation and referral coordination tools for independent specialty practices.
evidence: Two paid practice customers reported; clinical outcomes impact not established.

name: Ovary Labs
founders: Reproductive endocrinologist and molecular diagnostics scientist
description: A research platform developing patient-collected samples for earlier identification of reproductive health conditions.
evidence: Academic collaboration described; assay validation, IP ownership, and regulatory pathway are unknown.

name: NurtureLoop
founders: Postpartum nurse practitioner and healthcare marketplace operator
description: A care coordination platform connecting new parents with lactation, mental health, and postpartum clinical support.
evidence: Early user interviews and a community-clinic pilot reported; retention and outcomes data not yet available.

name: Vitalis Well
founders: Preventive medicine physician and consumer technology founder
description: A personalized preventive-health program that translates biomarker results into clinician-reviewed behavior plans.
evidence: Formal clinical advisory structure disclosed; prospective outcomes and adherence evidence are not yet published.

name: Pelvic Forward
founders: Pelvic-floor physical therapist and digital health product leader
description: A hybrid care program for pelvic-floor conditions combining remote physical therapy with specialist escalation.
evidence: Clinical advisor disclosed and early patient feedback collected; comparative outcomes remain unknown.

name: Serene Science
founders: Behavioral scientist and digital therapeutics operator
description: A structured mental-wellness program using evidence-based behavioral exercises and clinician escalation pathways.
evidence: Pilot design reviewed by clinical advisors; no published trial or health-system partnership located.

name: MammoSense Labs
description: A research-stage diagnostic platform focused on improving risk stratification and follow-up pathways for breast-health screening.
evidence: Research collaboration and prototype work described; clinical validation, reimbursement, and regulatory pathway remain unknown.

name: Bloomwell Behavioral
founders: Behavioral health clinician and employer-benefits operator
description: A structured digital program supporting stress and anxiety management with evidence-based exercises and clinician escalation pathways.
evidence: Clinical advisory structure disclosed and employer pilot planned; published outcomes are not yet available.
